une_premiere_lecture_de_votre_ciel_de_na: A first reading of your birth chart, designed to help you better understand the major forces that shape your personality.
chaque_naissance_marque_un_instant_uniqu: Each birth marks a unique moment. At the exact moment you came into the world, the planets occupied a precise position in the sky. This configuration forms your natal chart: a symbolic map of your personality, natural impulses, and major inner trends.
ce_rapport_essentiel_vous_offre_une_prem: This Essential report offers you a clear first reading of your birth chart. It highlights your three main astrological pillars — the Sun, the Moon, and the Ascendant — as well as the main planets that influence your way of thinking, loving, acting, and evolving.
l_astrologie_ne_fige_pas_votre_destin_et: Astrology does not fix your destiny and does not replace your free will. It acts more like a mirror: it helps you better understand your strengths, sensitivities, contradictions, and the paths that allow you to grow with greater awareness.
certaines_pages_vous_sembleront_immediat: Some pages may feel immediately familiar to you. Others may make more sense over time. Let your reading unfold naturally, without trying to analyze everything at once.
votre_theme_natal_n_est_pas_une_limite_c: Your natal chart is not a limit. It is an invitation to better know yourself, to recognize your light, and to move forward with more clarity on your own path.
votre_carte_du_ciel_ne_decide_pas_a_votr: Your birth chart does not decide for you. It reveals the forces with which you can create your life.
